title: Apollo (APO) Completes Emerald And Questex Deals To Build A B2B Events Platform
title_zh: Apollo (APO) 完成 Emerald 和 Questex 交易，打造 B2B 活动平台
summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) has completed the acquisitions of Emerald Holding and Questex. The deals combine the two businesses into a new B2B experiential events and media platform under Apollo-managed funds.
summary_zh: Apollo Global Management（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APO）已完成对 Emerald Holding 和 Questex 的收购。这些交易将两家公司合并为一个新的 B2B 体验活动和媒体平台，由 Apollo 管理的基金管理。

title: Cisco (CSCO) Stock Looks About Right As Security Deal Talk Grows
title_zh: 随着安全交易讨论的增多，思科（CSCO）股票看起来不错
summary: Cisco Systems has delivered a strong 131.2% total return over the past 5 years, yet current checks suggest the stock now sits close to its estimated intrinsic value rather than standing out as a clear bargain.
summary_zh: 过去 5 年，思科系统公司的总回报率高达 131.2%，但目前的调查显示，该股目前接近其估计的内在价值，而不是明显便宜的股票。

title: Apollo's 715p EasyJet Bid Forces Castlelake Into Higher-Offer Decision
title_zh: Apollo 的 715p EasyJet 出价迫使 Castlelake 做出更高报价的决定
summary: EasyJet (EJTTF), a UK discount airline, has backed a surprise takeover offer from Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO), a US investment firm with aircraft leasing and airline financing interests, increasing pressure on Castlelake, a US investment firm that has already made five...
summary_zh: 英国折扣航空公司易捷航空 (EJTTF) 出人意料地支持了美国投资公司阿波罗全球管理公司 (NYSE:APO) 的收购要约，阿波罗全球管理公司是一家从事飞机租赁和航空公司融资业务的美国投资公司，这给已经获得五项投资的美国投资公司 Castlelake 带来了更大的压力。

title: New York Yankees, Apollo in Talks for $3 Billion Financing Deal
title_zh: 纽约洋基队与 Apollo 正在洽谈 30 亿美元融资协议
summary: The New York Yankees, the most successful team in Major League Baseball history, are in advanced talks with  Apollo  Global Management to raise about $3 billion of financing, people familiar with the matter said.
summary_zh: 知情人士称，美国职业棒球大联盟历史上最成功的球队纽约洋基队正在与阿波罗全球管理公司进行高级谈判，以筹集约 30 亿美元的资金。
